title: Listen and Choose a Response — Errands

questions.stem: Does the pharmacy stay open late on Sundays?

options.A: I stayed late at work on Sunday.
options.B: It's next to the post office on Main Street.
options.C: Yes, it closes at noon on Sundays.
options.D: I think it closes early, but you could call to check.

questions.explanation: The correct reply admits uncertainty and suggests calling; the 'Yes' option contradicts staying open late.
questions.speaker: m6
